verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean triple is the same three fields, with the paper's T_1γ_d realized as PressureStream.streamPotential and the paper's (8.14) read left to right. First component: streamBeta (ε n • axial) Ψ_* = −∂_{ε·Z}Ψ_* = −ε ∂_Z T_1 γ_d, the scalar pulling out by linearity of the directional derivative (TemporalMeanUpdate.radialUpdate_smul_direction, line 688). Third component: the Lean writes streamGamma Ψ_* = (D_r + 1/R)Ψ_*, which is the left-hand form of the paper's (8.14); its equality with the paper's displayed γ_d − 𝒜_1γ_d is a separate lemma (axialUpdate_eq_desired_sub_alias) rather than part of the same statement. Second component: temporalAtIndex applied to the angular residual, the Δv of (8.20). The class memberships are stated as the conjunction temporalIncrementState_classes with exactly the exponents α+1, α, α, and also individually in TemporalMeanUpdate (meanClass_scaledRadialUpdate, meanClass_desiredIncrement, meanClass_axialUpdate). The Lean versions carry hypotheses the display leaves to the ambient lemma (smoothness, torus periodicity, radial support, 0 ≤ h, ChartScales.S n ≤ L n, and a bounded gap nativeIndex h n ≤ index n + D for the common chart index).
